result.title: SuperClip Pyramid for Video Temporal Grounding
result.summary: With the rapid expansion of online video content, video temporal grounding has become essential for localizing moments based on user-specific queries, comprising two subtasks: moment retrieval (MR) and highlight detection (HD). While recent approaches adopt DETR-style decoders or temporal pyramid architectures, they rely on single-scale feature maps or uniformly downsampled representations, limiting their ability to capture semantic boundaries and variable-length events. In this paper, we present SuperClip Video Temporal Grounding (SCVTG) built on a multi-scale temporal hierarchy that better captures distinctive events at various granularities. SCVTG constructs a SuperClip pyramid by grouping adjacent clips into semantically coherent segments, termed SuperClips. Further, to aggregate these SuperClips having variable duration and temporal location, we introduce a temporally adaptive kernel that aggregates SuperClips through temporally conditioned weights, enabling flexible aggregation. On top of this, we design relative saliency losses to guide the model in learning inter-clip importance, enhancing its ability to distinguish relevant events. Extensive experiments show that SCVTG achieves the best performance across five video temporal grounding benchmarks with promising gains.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 SCVTG，用多尺度时间层次构建 SuperClip 金字塔，将相邻片段归并为语义连贯的变长片段，并引入时间自适应核按时间条件权重聚合，同时设计相对显著性损失学习片段间重要性，以提升视频时刻检索与高光检测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其变长片段的条件加权聚合与「相对显著性损失」对片段重要性的监督，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与多粒度证据的动态分配提供可核查的线索，但论文本身面向视频定位，未涉及 latent 推理状态。
